releases.displayName: Devlog – Patch Update & Midnight DLC Support

items.text: Three days before the release of Midnight DLC, we’re rolling out a new patch for Before Exit: Gas Station that not only introduces multiple fixes and improvements, but also prepares the base game for full DLC support.
The game is now fully updated to support the upcoming Midnight DLC.
Make sure your game is updated to the latest version to avoid any issues when the DLC launches.
Added Arabic language support
Added missing ATM to some scenarios
Added flashlight keybind tip to the tutorial note
Added tutorial reminder to not move anything that isn’t on the list
Added achievement unlock re-check after each day (fix for rare achievement issues)
Fixed photo placement in “Into The Light” scenario animation
Removed light from broken garage sign in “After The Storm” scenario
Fixed outside lighting in “Demolition” scenario
Fixed toilet duplicate in “Fire Extinguishers” scenario
Fixed a bug in “Into The Garbage” mystery scenario that stopped the signs from lighting up
Adjusted random events spawn chance in selected scenarios
Improved colliders for clearing graffiti
Moved one of the signs in “Into The Garbage” mystery scenario to a more visible place
Adjusted leather chair collision in “Into the Sky” mystery scenario
Adjusted workbench collision in “Into the Sky” mystery scenario
Adjusted pickup collider for products inside the van during “Delivery” scenario
Adjusted mopping animation to always start on interaction
Adjusted camera angles in selected cut-scenes
Thank you for your continued support and for helping us improve the game with your feedback.
We’re very excited for you to experience Midnight DLC in just a few days. The night shift is about to get much darker…
Stay tuned. 🌑

releases.displayName: What's going on in Before Exit?

notes.title: Today We are bringing you fresh dose of screenshots from first planned DLC - Midnight.

items.text: Winter has arrived for good and It is important for us - One of our goals in this DLC is to catch that cold feeling and enclouse that feeling in our game.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45291235/e4da209ab15ba9319a577ef1d3ddb21b7dc25633.png"]

In this way, the -15°C outside helps set the mood, pushing us to turn that feeling into the cold and lonely atmosphere of the DLC. Honestly though, -5°C would have worked just fine too, without being such a pain to deal with...
[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/4182100/Before_Exit_Gas_Station__Midnight_DLC"]

In both DLC we want to reuse as little as possible from before (Exit, hehe). It forces us come up with new ideas and create new mechanics, but only this way we can achieve what we want - to make this DLC as different from main game as possible, while still having same fundamental principle in mind - that it is all about closing down Gas Station to begin with.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45291235/857fa263a0ae8ad7e14297fc50bcb6757b0cbea0.png"]
Yes, there will be more grass cutting going on... but this time we are briging heavy equipment!
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45291235/99fb878cc97a4130967db7f062e3f5a962db5447.png"]
Bears are coming back too... watch out not to be eaten!
